title: Simon 7.1.2: minimizing currents in a C² submanifold have stationary varifolds with locally bounded generalized mean curvature (registered obligation)
statement: Let ℓ ≤ k, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with spt T ⊆ N, T minimizing in N ∩ U (Simon 7.1.1, integer multiplicity competitors) and ∂T = 0 in U (vacuous for n = 0). Then for every integer multiplicity representation R = (M, θ, ξ) of T, the varifold v(M, θ) is stationary in N ∩ U (∫_M θ div_M X dH^n = 0 for all X ∈ C¹_c(U; ℝ^{n+k}) with X(x) ∈ T_xN for x ∈ N ∩ U) and has a generalized mean curvature H in U that is μ_V-essentially bounded on every compact subset of U.
